Original Decipher card face for [[Mon Calamari (Dark)]], rotated 180° from the archive scan [[:File:DS2-D-moncalamari-decipher-archive.gif]], no other change. Decipher's Dark Side card list scan shows this card Light Side up; this copy turns it so the Dark Side text reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no crop, no rescaling.

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/deathstar2/dark/images/moncalamari.gif moncalamari.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020721175415/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/deathstar2/dark/images/moncalamari.gif Internet Archive], 21 July 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: e5c4c06b9f1c135ac8dbe0ef96f16aaef666da1add05d27a6c688499d56c9e57.

The PC Holotable face is [[:File:DS2-D-moncalamari.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
